mentions.name: CLAW.md open standard
mentions.description: An open standard for sharing scheduled agentic automation jobs ("claws") as a single CLAW.md file, which contains metadata (name, schedule, personality, etc.) and one or more ordered tasks, each either a full agent run with tool use or a plain bash step.
mentions.source_excerpt: So also working on making CLAW.md a completely open standard for sharing https://clor.com/blog/claws-md-open-format-for-agentic-cron-jobs
